_source: Mined read-only from the zeldaret/tww decompilation at Z:/memRip/sources/tww and the ripped GZLE01 (Wind Waker USA) disc data at Z:/3d ripper/out/rip/GZLE01. Chapter: THE FORBIDDEN WOODS - the King of Red Lions sends Link to the Forest Haven, the Great Deku Tree explains that the Korok Makar has fallen into the Forbidden Woods, Link takes the Deku Leaf, glides to the Woods, kills the Mothula and Kalle Demos, frees Makar and is given Farore's Pearl. Same conventions as ww_story_outset.json and ww_story_fortress.json. Event names come from each stage's Stage.arc/event_list.dat (dumped to out/rip/GZLE01/godot/events/<stage>.json) and from the stage.dzs EVNT table. Triggers come from stage.dzs / room.dzr placement chunks: PLYR spawn points (params>>24 = index into the stage's EVNT table -> auto-started event), TagEv volumes (params: >>24 EVNT index, >>16&0xFF switch2, >>8&0xFF switch, &0xFF daTag_Event_c type; rot.z = required event bit) and TagIsl island-arrival volumes. Event-bit ids are authoritative numbers; the UNK_xxxx names are placeholders invented by the decomp team (include/d/d_save_event_flag.inc opens by saying every name in it is fake), so numeric ids are used here. IMPORTANT CORRECTION to the miner output: AttTag / AttTagB is NOT an event trigger. Both map to fpcNm_Tag_Attention_e (src/d/d_stage.cpp:628-629), whose parameter word is only { swSave = params & 0xFF, Type = (params>>8) & 0x03 } (include/d/actor/d_a_tag_attention.h:55-73) and whose only effect is dComIfGp_att_Look2RequestF - a camera look-at point (src/d/actor/d_a_tag_attention.cpp:49-70). tools/ww_story_mine.py decodes AttTag rows with the TagEv layout, so its 63 'KagoCam' AttTag rows in kindan and its 'meet_deku' AttTag row in Omori are decode artefacts, not triggers. Only the 5 real TagEv volumes in kindan and the 8 in sea room 41 are event triggers.

_checkpoints.note: This chapter has NO entry of its own in the continue table. It happens entirely after RODE_KORL (0x2A08), the first row of l_checkData, which stops the table forcing a stage and lets a continuing save resume wherever it was saved. RODE_KORL is therefore the chapter's hard prerequisite, exactly as the Forsaken Fortress chapter's last step leaves it.

related_gate.rule: Link may not land at an island in l_landingEvent[] until its arrival bit is set. The Forest Haven row is {dIsleRoom_ForestHaven_e (41), UNK_0A20} at src/d/d_com_inf_game.cpp:1277, so 0x0A20 is the bit that opens this chapter's island.

0x2A08.meaning: RODE_KORL: Link has boarded the King of Red Lions. Prerequisite for this whole chapter - it is what makes the game open enough to sail to the Forest Haven. Set by the Forsaken Fortress chapter.

0x0A80.meaning: The King of Red Lions has told Link, after Din's Pearl, to go to the Forest Haven. daShip_c::checkForceMessage forces message 0x5EC as long as the Din symbol is on the chart and this bit is clear; the bit is raised when the follow-up message 0x5ED finishes. It is the entry gate of this chapter.

0x1980.meaning: Link has boarded the King of Red Lions at least once since 0x0A80 was raised - i.e. he has heard the 'go to the Forest Haven' advice and got back in the boat. Only changes which advice line KoRL gives.

0x0A20.meaning: Link has arrived at the Forest Haven: the ARRIVAL_FST island-arrival cutscene has played. Raised by daTag_Island_c::demoInitProc via getArrivalFlag(), whose type-2 case returns this bit. Until it is set dComIfGs_checkSeaLandingEvent refuses to let Link land at sea room 41.
0x0A20.set_by: src/d/actor/d_a_tag_island.cpp:133 (demoInitProc -> onEventBit(getArrivalFlag())), type 2 mapping at src/d/actor/d_a_tag_island.cpp:85

0x2B80.meaning: The King of Red Lions has given his Forest Haven directions once (message 0x5F4). Purely a which-line-does-he-say flag inside the 0x0A20 branch of his advice ladder; it has no other reader in src/.

0x1801.meaning: The Great Deku Tree has spoken to Link - the meet_deku cutscene is done. This is the chapter's real mid-point flag: the Deku Leaf pickup actor refuses to spawn without it, the Baba Buds whose type is daJbo_Type_APPEAR_AFTER_DEKU_TREE_e switch to their normal (climbable) type when it is set, and the Forest Haven hint tag turns itself off once it is set. Nothing in src/ raises it, so it comes from event data (the same way 0x0520 does in the Outset chapter).
0x1801.set_by: (event data - no onEventBit for it exists anywhere in src/; the meet_deku event is the only thing that can plausibly raise it)

0x1904.meaning: Link has heard Makar's whole speech in the Forest Haven (message chain 0x14C2..0x14C4 finished). After it, talking to Makar there gives 0x14C5 instead of restarting at 0x14C2.

0x1820.meaning: Not raised by this chapter, but it ends it: once 0x1820 is set daNpc_Cb1_c::create returns cPhs_ERROR_e unconditionally for every non-BossDie Makar, so the Forest Haven Makar placed by this chapter disappears. Elsewhere the same bit is the second-visit Forsaken Fortress state (it picks sea room 1 layer 3 and drives the endless-night world).

0x0A08.meaning: The King of Red Lions has reacted to Farore's Pearl and pointed Link at the next chapter. checkForceMessage forces message 0x5F6 while the Farore symbol is on the chart and this bit is clear; the bit goes up when the follow-up 0x5F7 ends. This is the chapter's exit.

0x2A02.meaning: Link has boarded the King of Red Lions again after 0x0A08 - the post-pearl equivalent of 0x1980. Advice-line flag only.

0x1440.meaning: PLACED_FARORES_PEARL - Farore's Pearl has been set on its goddess statue. NOT part of this chapter (that is the Tower of the Gods chapter, driven by d_a_obj_doguu), listed only to mark where this chapter's output is consumed.

0x3220.meaning: KALLE_DEMOS_TRIALS_CLEAR - one of the few non-placeholder names in d_save_event_flag.inc. It is NOT set by the kinBOSS fight: d_a_bmd only raises it on the Ganon's Tower rematch, i.e. when dComIfGp_getStartStageName()[0] == 'X'. Recorded here so a remake does not wire it to the real boss.
0x3220.set_by: src/d/actor/d_a_bmd.cpp:523 (only on stage names beginning with 'X')

0x1610.meaning: LATER CHAPTER (Wind Temple), included because it is what uses my stage Otkura. Makar's evInitEnd raises it together with 0x1604 when his message 0x1526 ends, and in the same breath calls dComIfGp_setNextStage("Otkura", 0xE6, 0, 8) - re-entering the Forest Haven waterfall cave at spawn 230, layer 8, where the awake_kokiri (Wind God's Aria) event auto-plays.

0x1604.meaning: LATER CHAPTER (Wind Temple). Set with 0x1610. It is what lets Makar exist on the sea stage (daNpc_Cb1_c::create line 287) and what daTag_Island_c::otherCheck requires before the type-6 Gale Isle arrival event may play.

0x1880.meaning: LATER CHAPTER. Makar's waterfall-cave (Otkura) small-talk has been heard once: message 0x151E ends. Switches his opening line from 0x1519 to 0x151F.

0x1840.meaning: LATER CHAPTER. Link has tried the Wind Waker on Makar in the cave once (message 0x1521 ends). Afterwards his conducting line is 0x1522 instead of 0x1520.

De1.name: The Great Deku Tree
De1.placement: Omori room 0 at (44, 355, -388), rot.y 12743. param 0 on layers 0 and 1 (the normal day/night pair), param 1 on layers 10 and 11.
De1.index_rule: UNKNOWN. Every single function body in d_a_npc_de1.cpp is a /* Nonmatching */ stub (52 of them in a 317-line file) and the class in include/d/actor/d_a_npc_de1.h has no member variables at all, so no l_evn_tbl and no fopAcM_orderOtherEventId call can be read out of the decomp. The header does declare the usual NPC event shape - decideType(int), eventOrder(), checkOrder(), event_actionInit(int), event_proc(), demo(), privateCut(), endEvent() - so the Deku Tree orders its own events the same way Tetra and Aryll do; the names and the state byte cannot be recovered.

Cb1.name: Makar
Cb1.file: src/d/actor/d_a_npc_cb1.cpp (header comment says 'Player - Makar'; the HIO child is named マコレ)
Cb1.objname: src/d/d_stage.cpp OBJNAME row maps 'Cb1' to fpcNm_NPC_CB1_e
Cb1.table_source: src/d/actor/d_a_npc_cb1.cpp:2903-2914 (l_eventNameTbl, VERSION_USA/PAL branch; the JPN/DEMO copy is at 2960-2971)
Cb1.index_rule: m8DD is the request byte. daNpc_Cb1_c::eventOrder (src/d/actor/d_a_npc_cb1.cpp:2635-2649): m8DD == 5 -> orderSpeakEvent (plain talk); m8DD == 6 or 7 -> just flag dEvtCnd_CANTALK_e / CANTALKITEM_e; m8DD < 5 -> m8E3 = m8DD and fopAcM_orderOtherEventId(this, mEventIdx[m8E3]), so the byte indexes l_eventNameTbl directly. rescueNpcAction sets m8DD = 0 -> cb_rescue (src/d/actor/d_a_npc_cb1.cpp:2148-2168). musicNpcAction sets m8DD = 7 in the waterfall cave and 6 elsewhere when Link is in attention range.
Cb1.type_from_params: include/d/actor/d_a_npc_cb1.h:61-66 - param 0 BossDie (the kinBOSS rescue copy), 1 Forest (Forest Haven), 2 WaterFall (Otkura), 3 Ekaze, 4 Kaze, 5 KazeBoss.
Cb1.which_copy_lives: daNpc_Cb1_c::create, src/d/actor/d_a_npc_cb1.cpp:264-306, walks a ladder and deletes every copy whose type does not match the current story state: MASTER_SWORD_3 -> only KazeBoss; 0x2910 -> only Kaze; 0x2E02 -> only Ekaze; 0x1610 -> only on stage 'sea' and only with 0x1604; MASTER_SWORD_2 -> only WaterFall; 0x1820 -> none at all; PEARL_FARORE -> only Forest; otherwise none. So the Forest Haven Makar exists exactly between getting Farore's Pearl and getting Master Sword 2.
Cb1.placements: Omori room 0 (1803, 380, -618) param 1, on layers 0 and 1. Otkura room 0 (20, -222, 565) param 2, on layers 0 and 1. No Cb1 is placed in kinBOSS at all - the rescue copy is created at runtime by Kalle Demos (src/d/actor/d_a_bmd.cpp:1490 during the death sequence, and src/d/actor/d_a_bmd.cpp:1977 on any later entry to the room before the pearl is taken).

Bj1..Bj9.name: The Koroks (generic)
Bj1..Bj9.objname: src/d/d_stage.cpp:731 OBJNAME("Bj1", fpcNm_NPC_BJ1_e, 255, 59); Bj2..Bj9 map to the same profile
Bj1..Bj9.index_rule: UNKNOWN - d_a_npc_bj1.cpp is 788 lines of which 119 are /* Nonmatching */ stubs and it contains no string literals at all, so no event table can be read.
Bj1..Bj9.placements: Omori room 0: Bj2,Bj3,Bj4,Bj5,Bj6,Bj9 on layers 0/1/10/11; Bj1,Bj7,Bj8 only on layers 10/11. sea room 41 (unlayered): one Bj1 and one Bj8 on the Forest Haven exterior.
Bj1..Bj9.layer_note: getLayerNo has no branch for Omori (src/d/d_com_inf_game.cpp:184-268), so Omori only ever resolves to layer 0 (day) or 1 (night) unless something forces a layer through the 4th argument of dComIfGp_setNextStage. Nothing in src/ forces an Omori layer. What selects the bigger layer-10/11 Korok crowd is therefore UNDETERMINED.

Bkm.name: Kalle Demos
Bkm.file: src/d/actor/d_a_bmd.cpp (header comment 'Boss - Kalle Demos (Core) / 森ボス (Forest Boss)'; tentacles in d_a_bmdhand.cpp and d_a_bmdfoot.cpp)
Bkm.placement: kinBOSS room 0 - the report lists it unlayered with params 0
Bkm.on_death: src/d/actor/d_a_bmd.cpp:494-566 end(): at frame 0x276 it calls dComIfGs_onStageBossEnemy() and fopAcM_createWarpFlower(). Earlier, at case 102 (src/d/actor/d_a_bmd.cpp:1490), it creates Makar (fpcNm_NPC_CB1_e, param 0) at the flower's position - that is the rescue.
Bkm.on_reentry: src/d/actor/d_a_bmd.cpp:1972-1980: if the boss is already dead and Farore's Pearl has NOT been taken, the boss actor deletes itself and instead creates Makar (param 0) at (100, 0, 800) so the rescue can still be played.

gmos.name: Mothula (mini-boss) / Mothula Larva
gmos.file: src/d/actor/d_a_gm.cpp (header comment 'Mini-Boss - Mothula / Enemy - Mothula Larva')
gmos.placement: kinMB room 10 at (44, 300, -22), params 0x19000000. kindan also places gmos in rooms 9 and 15.

supporting_objects.Ojtree: src/d/actor/d_a_obj_ojtree.cpp - 'Tall thin poles leading to the Deku Leaf (Forest Haven interior)'. 9 unlayered copies plus 1 on layer 7 in Omori. OBJNAME src/d/d_stage.cpp:903.
supporting_objects.Olift: src/d/actor/d_a_leaflift.cpp - 'Object - Forest Haven - Lilypad lift'. Omori room 0 (1398, 358, 307), layers 0 and 1. OBJNAME src/d/d_stage.cpp:617. It is a named actor in the LIFT_UP event.
supporting_objects.itemDek: src/d/actor/d_a_deku_item.cpp - 'Item - Deku Leaf (collectable)'. Omori room 0 (-792, 5035, -904), layers 0 and 1, params 2. OBJNAME src/d/d_stage.cpp:649.
supporting_objects.jbaba: src/d/actor/d_a_jbo.cpp - 'Object - Baba Bud'. daJbo_Type_APPEAR_AFTER_DEKU_TREE_e copies stay inert until 0x1801 (src/d/actor/d_a_jbo.cpp:123-128). OBJNAME src/d/d_stage.cpp:697.
supporting_objects.Nh: src/d/actor/d_a_nh.cpp - 'Item - Forest Firefly'. Two copies in Omori; the exporter could not resolve a model for them. OBJNAME src/d/d_stage.cpp:701.
supporting_objects.Mori1: src/d/actor/d_a_mdoor.cpp - 'Object - Wooden/Metal bars (Forbidden Woods, ...)'. One in kinMB (the bars that seal the Mothula room). OBJNAME src/d/d_stage.cpp:459.
supporting_objects.Warpf: src/d/actor/d_a_warpf.cpp - the boss warp flower. Refuses to exist unless dComIfGs_isStageBossEnemy() (src/d/actor/d_a_warpf.cpp:265-268).
supporting_objects.Warpfo: src/d/actor/d_a_warpfout.cpp - the receiving warp flower. One unlayered copy in Omori; it is the named actor of the BOSS_WARPOUT event.
supporting_objects.Bitem: src/d/actor/d_a_boss_item.cpp - the boss heart container. kinBOSS room 0 at (704, 0, 44) with params 4 = dSv_save_c::STAGE_FW. It spawns the item only while isStageBossEnemy(4) is true and isStageLife(4) is false (src/d/actor/d_a_boss_item.cpp:24-38).

trigger.detail: Talk to the King of Red Lions anywhere at sea. daShip_c::checkForceMessage (src/d/actor/d_a_ship.cpp:342-360) forces message 0x5EC the moment dComIfGs_isSymbol(dSymbol_DIN_e) is true and 0x0A80 is clear - i.e. as soon as Link owns Din's Pearl. The follow-on line 0x5ED raises 0x0A80 when it ends.

steps.notes: Requires Din's Pearl, which is player-collect state (dSymbol_DIN_e) rather than an event bit, so it cannot be expressed in requires_bits. Boarding the boat again afterwards raises 0x1980 (src/d/actor/d_a_ship.cpp:1572-1574), which only swaps which advice line he gives.

trigger.detail: A TagIsl volume in sea room 41 at (224460, 0, 201920), scale 3.0, params 0x06FF1A02: eventNo (params>>24) = 6 = EVNT[6] = ARRIVAL_FST, switch2 0xFF, switch (params>>8&0xFF) = 0x1A = 26, type (params&0xFF) = 2 = the Forest Haven island. daTag_Island_c::checkArea uses scale.x * 10000 = 30000 units XZ and scale.y * 10000 = 30000 units Y. If Link is NOT on the boat the actor swaps the event for ARRIVAL_FST2 (src/d/actor/d_a_tag_island.cpp:71).

steps.notes: arrivalTerms() refuses to fire the event again once 0x0A20 is set. Setting 0x0A20 is also what unlocks landing at room 41 at all (src/d/d_com_inf_game.cpp:1277). The event script is camera + Ship + a TELOP_ON with tlpNo 3 (the island-name banner) + four message boxes; no .stb is involved.

trigger.detail: Talk to the King of Red Lions after arriving. His advice ladder reaches the 0x0A20 branch (src/d/actor/d_a_ship.cpp:558-570): if the Farore symbol is already on the chart he says 0x5F6, else if 0x2B80 is set he says 0x5F5, else 0x5F4. Ending 0x5F4 raises 0x2B80.

steps.notes: Flavour only - nothing gates on 0x2B80 except this same ladder.

trigger.detail: Three sea room 41 spawns auto-play a camera look at the Forest Haven and its surroundings: spawn 2 -> EVNT[19] = R29LOOK_KINDAN at (225527, 3763, 200112) (the look up at the Forbidden Woods), spawn 1 -> EVNT[22] = R29LOOK_TAKARA at (228064, 5504, 202032), spawn 4 -> EVNT[23] = R29LOOK_MANTEN at (227018, 4958, 198172). A layer-7 TagEv at (228144, 5500, 202139), params 0x16FF51FF, switch 0x51 = 81, orders R29LOOK_TAKARA again, and another layer-7 TagEv at (230316, 1015, 198827), params 0x0CFFFFFF, orders EVNT[12] = R29WATERFALL.

steps.notes: 'R29' is room 0x29 = 41 = dIsleRoom_ForestHaven_e (include/d/d_save.h:345), which is what identifies this whole family of events as Forest Haven cameras: R29LOOK_KINDAN, R29LOOK_MORI, R29LOOK_TAKARA, R29LOOK_MANTEN, R29LOOK_SHIP, R29WATERFALL. All are pure CAMERA/Link/TIMEKEEPER scripts with no bit and no item. R29LOOK_MORI (EVNT[38]) and R29LOOK_SHIP (EVNT[24]) exist in the event list but no spawn or TagEv in the ripped room 41 data orders them. CAVEAT: the two layer-7 TagEvs can never load under the story rules - getLayerNo has no branch for sea room 41, so it always returns 0 or 1 (src/d/d_com_inf_game.cpp:184-268), and layerLoader only decodes the ACT<n>/SCO<n> table for the selected layer (src/d/d_stage.cpp:2070-2149). What selects layer 7 here is undetermined.

trigger.detail: Five identical TagEv volumes strung across the mouth of the Forest Haven waterfall at (230099 / 230179 / 230276 / 230389 / 230529, 672, ~198865), scale (1, 3, 1), params 0x38FFFFFF: eventNo 0x38 = EVNT[56] = 'fall', switch2 0xFF, switch 0xFF, type 0xFF, rot.z = -1 so no event bit gates them.

steps.notes: The 'fall' script is only DIRECTOR(WAIT, NEXT) + TIMEKEEPER(COUNTDOWN, WAIT) - i.e. it exists purely to run the DIRECTOR 'NEXT' stage change. It is the door from the Great Sea into the Forest Haven interior. The ripped data contains no SCLS exit record from sea room 41 to Omori, so this TagEv is the only evidence of the link. A sixth TagEv at (224319, 1031, 192271) with params 0x36FFFFFF orders EVNT[54] = 'nitendo' with the same DIRECTOR/NEXT shape - that is the Nintendo Gallery on the islet beside the Forest Haven, not story.

trigger.detail: Omori room 0 spawn 5 at (-2991, 100, -1556), rot.y -90 deg, params 0x03FF0000: event index (params>>24) = 3 = EVNT[3] = MORI_INSIDE. That spawn is at the foot of the waterfall, i.e. exactly where the 'fall' trigger drops Link.

steps.notes: The script is Link(002n_walk, 001n_wait) + two CAMERA UNITRANS/PAUSE pairs + RESTOREPOS: the establishing pan across the inside of the Forest Haven. Omori's whole EVNT table is only 4 entries: meet_deku, getperl_deku, BOSS_WARPOUT, MORI_INSIDE.

trigger.detail: The Great Deku Tree (De1, Omori room 0 at (44, 355, -388), param 0 on layers 0 and 1) orders the event itself - include/d/actor/d_a_npc_de1.h declares the standard NPC ordering shape (decideType, eventOrder, checkOrder, event_actionInit, event_proc, demo, privateCut, endEvent). The radius and the state byte CANNOT be recovered: every body in d_a_npc_de1.cpp is a /* Nonmatching */ stub and the class has no members. There is no TagEv in Omori at all, and the one AttTag at (-1346, 3096, -775) is a camera attention point, not a trigger.

steps.notes: The event script is a single PACKAGE actor whose PLAY action carries FileName 'meet_deku.stb', Stage 'Omori', RoomNo 0, StartCode 213, Layer -1 - and Omori spawn 213 at (1524, 358, 617) is exactly the spawn whose params (0x00FF0000) carry EVNT index 0 = meet_deku. So the baked cutscene and the spawn point are two halves of the same thing. The 0x1801 attribution is an inference, not a quoted line: nothing in src/ raises 0x1801, and meet_deku is the only Forest Haven event that could, but the three readers of 0x1801 (the Deku Leaf, the Baba Buds whose type is literally named daJbo_Type_APPEAR_AFTER_DEKU_TREE_e, and the Forest Haven hint tag) all describe exactly the post-meet_deku state.

trigger.detail: Actor-ordered events with no entry in Omori's 4-slot EVNT table and no trigger volume, so they are ordered by their own actors through dComIfGp_evmng_getEventIdx(name): 'Calling' is a Bj6 (Korok) script - ACTION, TALK_MSG, WAIT, WAIT, TALK_MSG plus Link's 008e_talk; 'LIFT_UP' pairs De1 with Olift (the lilypad lift) and a FIXEDFRM camera; 'contact', 'CyuCyu_STR', 'CyuCyu_RET' and the 23-cut 'DE_CHUCHU' are all De1 animation/camera pieces.

steps.notes: Which of these plays when is UNDETERMINED - both d_a_npc_de1.cpp and d_a_npc_bj1.cpp (788 lines, 119 Nonmatching stubs, zero string literals) are stubbed out, and none of the six names appears anywhere in the placement data. The 0x1801 requirement is my ordering assumption, not a gate found in the data. Grouped as one step because they are the same beat: the Koroks and the Deku Tree filling the Forest Haven while Link climbs.

trigger.detail: The itemDek actor (src/d/actor/d_a_deku_item.cpp) at Omori room 0 (-792, 5035, -904) on layers 0 and 1, params 2, at the top of the Ojtree poles. daDekuItem_c::_create returns cPhs_ERROR_e both if its item bit is already collected and if !dComIfGs_isEventBit(0x1801), so the leaf physically does not exist until the Deku Tree has spoken. Touching its 50-radius / 100-height collision cylinder runs mode_getdemo and calls fopAcM_createItemForTrBoxDemo(pos, dItemNo_DEKU_LEAF_e).

steps.notes: 'item' is a trigger kind this file introduces - see the report. Omori also carries a TagHt (hint tag) at (-526, 105, -242) whose case-9 condition turns it off once 0x1801 is set (src/d/actor/d_a_tag_hint.cpp:174-181), i.e. the 'go see the Deku Tree' hint.

trigger.detail: Link leaves the Forest Haven, climbs to the high ledge and glides on the Deku Leaf to the Forbidden Woods. The receiving point is kindan room 0 spawn 0 at (312, 2397, 11672) (spawn 1, 181 units behind it at (312, 2397, 11491), is the one both kinMB and kinBOSS return to).

steps.notes: UNDETERMINED how the game gets here. The ripped data has no SCLS exit from sea room 41 or from Omori to kindan (Omori's exits list is empty and sea's 27 exits contain none for kindan), and door_targets.json only knows kindan room 0 spawn 1 as the return from kinBOSS/kinMB. So the outward link is either an exit record the exporter did not pick up or a code-side transition. The Deku Leaf requirement is from the real game, not from a gate in the data.

trigger.detail: A TagEv at (317, 2400, 11492), scale 5, params 0x04FF36FF: eventNo 4 = EVNT[4] = TELOP_FOREST, switch2 0xFF, switch 0x36 = 54, type 0xFF, rot.z -1 (no bit gate). It sits on top of kindan room 0 spawn 1.

steps.notes: The dungeon-name banner: an 11-cut CAMERA sweep with SAVE/LOAD around it plus MESSAGE(WAIT, TELOP_ON, TELOP_OFF). Its switch 54 is what stops it replaying.

trigger.detail: The four remaining stage-level TagEv volumes in kindan, each with rot.z = -1 (no event-bit gate) and type 0xFF: params 0x002439FF -> EVNT[0] KagoCam, switch2 36, switch 57, at (-5755, 562, -4453), scale (2, 3, 0.5); params 0x011618FF -> EVNT[1] BomCam, switch2 22, switch 24, at (-5586, -111, -10679); params 0x02FF1EFF -> EVNT[2] StartCam, switch 30, at (229, 5360, -4266), scale (5, 7, 5); params 0x052F31FF -> EVNT[5] WarpCam01, switch2 47, switch 49, at (625, 5478, -5474).

steps.notes: All four are pure CAMERA + ALL(dummy) scripts - room-reveal cameras, no bit and no item. 'kago' is basket/cage, so KagoCam is most likely the hanging-cage room. kindan's EVNT table also holds OriCam (index 3) and 'dummy' (6); nothing in the placement data orders OriCam, and the event list carries WarpCam02 and SHOKUDAI_SWITCH which are not in the EVNT table at all. This step exists to record that the 63 further AttTag/AttTagB rows the miner prints for kindan as 'KagoCam' are decode artefacts: AttTag is fpcNm_Tag_Attention_e, a camera look-at point with no event index (see _source).

trigger.detail: Three TRES chests in kindan. The dungeon map: 'takara' in room 0 at (2166, 2738, 9838), item byte 0x4C = dItemNo_MAP_e. The compass: 'takara' in room 7 at (-6638, 6012, -4377), item byte 0x4D = dItemNo_COMPASS_e. The big key: 'takara4' in room 13 at (-5369, 563, -4455), item byte 0x4E = dItemNo_BOSS_KEY_e. A 'takara2' in room 7 at (-7827, 6129, -4959) carries 0x15 = dItemNo_SMALL_KEY_e.

steps.notes: Item identification comes from the high byte of the ripped TRES record's rot.z field (e.g. 19711 = 0x4CFF -> 0x4C). That reading is what makes the three dungeon-item chests land on exactly MAP/COMPASS/BOSS_KEY and the kinMB chest on BOOMERANG, which is why I trust it - but it does NOT agree with daTbox_c::getItemNo, which reads fopAcM_GetParam(this) & 0x7F (src/d/actor/d_a_tbox.cpp:402-405); the exporter's params/rot split for TRES entries must differ from the actor's runtime parameter word. Marked medium for that reason. Four further chests in kindan read 0x1F (JOY_PENDANT) and three read values (0xE7, 0xF5, 0xA4) that are not plain item ids.

trigger.detail: Entering kinMB from kindan room 9 spawn 1 at (23, 7448, -12929) arrives at kinMB room 10 spawn 0 (73, -1, 1487). The mini-boss is 'gmos' at (44, 300, -22), params 0x19000000, which maps to fpcNm_GM_e = d_a_gm.cpp, 'Mini-Boss - Mothula / Enemy - Mothula Larva'. A 'Mori1' (d_a_mdoor.cpp, 'Wooden/Metal bars') seals the room. The step completes when Mothula dies.

steps.notes: 'defeat' is a trigger kind this file introduces - see the report. kinMB has NO EVNT table and NO event scripts of its own beyond the shared defaults, and its single trigger volume is an AttTagB (a camera attention point, not an event tag), so nothing here is cutscene-driven. What the death opens is not readable: d_a_gm.cpp yields no onSwitch/isSwitch/param references to grep, so the link from Mothula's death to the Mori1 bars is inferred from the room layout only.

trigger.detail: The 'takara3' TRES chest in kinMB room 10 at (-1243, 27, -1399), rot.z = 11775 = 0x2DFF whose high byte 0x2D is dItemNo_BOOMERANG_e. Eight 'item' actors (params 0x03FF0401) ring the chest.

steps.notes: The dungeon item of the Forbidden Woods. kindan's own stage table carries a 'takara3' record for the same chest with the item byte reading 0xFF; kinMB's copy is the one with the real value.

trigger.detail: Link enters kinBOSS at room 0 spawn 0 (192, 0, 1865) or spawn 1 (191, 0, 1615) and fights 'Bkm' = fpcNm_BMD_e = d_a_bmd.cpp, Kalle Demos, with 20 BMDHAND ceiling tentacles and 8 BMDFOOT floor tentacles created in its _create (health 15). Its death routine end() runs a fixed script: at frame 0x276 it calls dComIfGs_onStageBossEnemy() and fopAcM_createWarpFlower(); earlier, at case 102, it creates Makar (fpcNm_NPC_CB1_e, param 0 = BossDie) at the flower position.

steps.notes: The 'boss defeated' state is NOT an event bit: dComIfGs_onStageBossEnemy() writes STAGE_BOSS_ENEMY into the per-stage dSv_memory_c for dSv_save_c::STAGE_FW = 4 (include/d/d_save.h:634, 665-667, 884). A remake needs a separate per-dungeon flag for it. KALLE_DEMOS_TRIALS_CLEAR (0x3220) is deliberately NOT set here - d_a_bmd only raises it when the stage name starts with 'X', i.e. the Ganon's Tower rematch (src/d/actor/d_a_bmd.cpp:518-525). kinBOSS has no EVNT table at all.

trigger.detail: The 'Bitem' actor in kinBOSS room 0 at (704, 0, 44) with params 4 = dSv_save_c::STAGE_FW. daBossItem_Create calls fopAcM_createItemForBoss only while dComIfGs_isStageBossEnemy(4) is true and dComIfGs_isStageLife(4) is false, then always returns cPhs_ERROR_e - so it is a one-shot spawner that re-arms on every room load until the container is taken.

steps.gives_item: Heart Container (via fopAcM_createItemForBoss; the STAGE_LIFE dungeon flag records it, not an event bit)
steps.notes: STAGE_LIFE, like STAGE_BOSS_ENEMY, is a per-stage dungeon flag in dSv_memory_c, not an event bit.

trigger.detail: Makar orders it himself. The param-0 (BossDie) Makar created by the dying boss runs daNpc_Cb1_c::rescueNpcAction, which sets m8DD = 0; eventOrder then does fopAcM_orderOtherEventId(this, mEventIdx[0]) and mEventIdx[0] is l_eventNameTbl[0] = "cb_rescue". No distance test is involved - the actor is placed by the death sequence and orders the event as it comes up. On a later entry to the room the same param-0 Makar is created by the boss actor's _create at (100, 0, 800) when the boss is already dead and Farore's Pearl has not been taken.

steps.notes: The script is Cb1(OFFSET_LINK, SET_GOAL, TO_LINK, then five MSG_SET/MSG_END pairs for messages 5201-5205 = 0x1451-0x1455) + Link(001n_wait, 003n_dash, 001n_wait) + a FIXEDFRM camera. Makar's plain talk line afterwards is 0x1456 (getMsg, isTypeBossDie). The USA/PAL init picks rescueNpcAction only while dComIfGs_isStageBossEnemy(STAGE_FW) is still false, and waitNpcAction once it is set - so the rescue speech plays exactly once, during the death sequence. No .stb: cb_rescue is not one of the 49 baked cutscenes.

trigger.detail: The warp flower 'Warpf' (d_a_warpf.cpp) created by the dying boss. daWarpf_c::CreateInit returns cPhs_ERROR_e unless dComIfGs_isStageBossEnemy(), then picks its event: checkEndDemo() for STAGE_FW is checkItemGet(dItemNo_PEARL_FARORE_e, TRUE), so before the pearl it uses WARP_WIND and after it uses WARP_WIND_AFTER.

steps.notes: WARP_WIND is the only difference between the two: it has a Cb1 track (TO_LINK, WARP) so Makar is carried out with Link; WARP_WIND_AFTER is identical minus Makar. Both end with DIRECTOR(WAIT, FADE, NEXT).

trigger.detail: Omori room 0 spawn 215 at (1754, 358, -13), rot.y -77 deg, params 0x02FF0000: event index 2 = EVNT[2] = BOSS_WARPOUT. The receiving flower is the unlayered 'Warpfo' (d_a_warpfout.cpp) in Omori, which is the named actor of the script.

steps.notes: Warpfo(WARP1..WARP4, END) + Link(001n_wait, 048warp, 001n_wait) + DIRECTOR(PLAYER_NODRAW, FADE, PLAYER_DRAW). The sea stage carries its own BOSS_WARPOUT (EVNT[39]) for the dungeons whose flower lands on an island.

trigger.detail: Omori room 0 spawn 214 at (1774, 358, 7), rot.y -77 deg, params 0x01FF0000: event index 1 = EVNT[1] = getperl_deku. Spawn 214 sits 20 units from spawn 215, so the pearl ceremony runs straight out of the warp-out. The event script is one PACKAGE actor whose PLAY action carries FileName 'getperl_deku.stb', Stage 'Omori', RoomNo 0, StartCode 214, Layer -1. Like meet_deku the Deku Tree actor is the thing that can order it, and De1's code is entirely stubbed.

steps.notes: How the .stb hands over the item is readable: daDemo00_c::execute, when the demo actor's prm id is 5, parses one byte out of the stb parameter block and indexes l_itemNo[] - entry 4 is dItemNo_PEARL_FARORE_e - then calls execItemGet (src/d/actor/d_a_demo00.cpp:714-733). Taking the pearl runs item_func which calls dComIfGs_onSymbol(dSymbol_FARORE_e) (src/d/d_item.cpp:1082); dComIfGs_checkGetItem(dItemNo_PEARL_FARORE_e) IS that symbol (src/d/d_com_inf_game.cpp:1107-1110). No event bit is involved, which is why this chapter's payoff is item state and not a bit. Side effects: the Forest Haven map image switches (src/d/d_s_room.cpp:271-272), the TagRet return-tag deletes itself (src/d/actor/d_a_tag_ret.cpp:40-42), and the boss warp flower switches to WARP_WIND_AFTER.

trigger.detail: Makar, now living in the Forest Haven: Cb1 param 1 (isTypeForest) at Omori room 0 (1803, 380, -618) on layers 0 and 1. daNpc_Cb1_c::create only lets this copy live while dComIfGs_checkGetItem(dItemNo_PEARL_FARORE_e) is true and none of MASTER_SWORD_2/3, 0x2910, 0x2E02, 0x1610 or 0x1820 is set. musicNpcAction has him play his cello and sets m8DD = 6 when Link is inside l_HIO.mNpc.mMaxAttnDistXZ, which only raises the CANTALK condition, so this is an ordinary talk. getMsg returns 0x14C2 the first time and 0x14C5 after 0x1904.

steps.notes: The message chain is 0x14C2 -> 0x14C3 -> 0x14C4, and ending 0x14C4 raises 0x1904 (next_msgStatus). Requires Farore's Pearl, which is item state and not an event bit, so requires_bits is empty. Note that the two extra Koroks (Bj1, Bj7, Bj8) and the second Deku Tree variant (De1 param 1) only exist on Omori layers 10 and 11, which getLayerNo can never select for this stage - see _actors.Bj1..Bj9.

trigger.detail: Talk to the King of Red Lions with Farore's Pearl in hand. checkForceMessage forces message 0x5F6 while dComIfGs_isSymbol(dSymbol_FARORE_e) is true and 0x0A08 is clear; ending the follow-on 0x5F7 raises 0x0A08, after which his advice ladder enters the 0x0A08 branch and points at the next chapter. Boarding again then raises 0x2A02.

steps.notes: This is the chapter's exit. What follows - setting the pearl on its goddess statue and raising PLACED_FARORES_PEARL (0x1440) via d_a_obj_doguu - belongs to the Tower of the Gods chapter, not here.

trigger.detail: NOT PART OF THIS CHAPTER, recorded because Otkura is one of the chapter's stages. Otkura's whole EVNT table is one entry, awake_kokiri, and room 0 spawn 230 at (-5, -222, 68), params 0x00FF0000, carries index 0, so arriving there auto-plays it. What sends Link there is Makar: daNpc_Cb1_c::evInitEnd, when his message 0x1526 ends, calls dComIfGp_setNextStage("Otkura", 0xE6 = 230, 0, 8) and raises 0x1610 and 0x1604 in the same breath.

steps.notes: This is the Wind God's Aria duet that awakens Makar as the Sage of Wind, i.e. the Wind Temple chapter, long after the Forbidden Woods. It is here only so the mining of Otkura is complete and so nobody wires it to this chapter. The cave's Makar is Cb1 param 2 (isTypeWaterFall) at (20, -222, 565) on layers 0 and 1, and create() only lets him live once dComIfGs_checkGetItem(dItemNo_MASTER_SWORD_2_e) is true - so Otkura is EMPTY of story content for the whole Forbidden Woods chapter. Otkura's other two scripts, cb_tact and cb_tactCancel, are the conducting attempt and its cancel. Layer 8, which Makar forces, contains no actors at all in the ripped data (the only layered Otkura actors are four Lamps on layer 7); layer 7 is likewise unreachable through getLayerNo, which has no Otkura branch.
